limits: Linux coverage is one emulated Alpine guest, not every distribution or a native host.
Windows checks ran on one Windows 11 host.
Framework integrations were tested against one version of each SDK, offline and with one live run each; no MCP server, collector or tracing backend was used.
The full source suite ran on Python 3.12 at the release revision; Python 3.11 and 3.13 to 3.15 ran the installed-wheel checker, not the source suite.

The first Linux guest boot stopped with a kernel panic (IO-APIC timer check) while the host was running the source suite; the first guest run then started before the guest's venv had pip. Both were set aside; the recorded Linux result is a clean boot and run of the same wheel.
The framework SDKs were installed only in the Windows extras environment; the Linux guest checked the core package and the integrations' missing-extra import errors.

pending.public_docs_support: The 2.1.2 site and docs pages state 2.1.2 as published; they deploy only after PyPI publication. Private vulnerability reporting is enabled.
